restore.description:
The current file at `{path}` will be backed up and replaced with the latest published version of **{blueprint_name}**. Local edits cannot be merged.

If the file is still located under `hippo/`, existing YAML `use_blueprint.path` references will be migrated to `hippotastic/`. If any reference cannot be migrated safely, the old file will be kept.

Select **Submit** to confirm the replacement.
